Name: MoreWeapons Mod
Author: Joco80
Description:
This mod adds 20 new weapons to the game, including unique textures and stats. Once installed, you can buy the weapons for the Adventurer's Guild. All the weapons were created by Sasara and me. Enjoy!

[color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 3.13.4 or later.[/color]

[size=5]Install:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage:[/size]
[list]
[*]Purchase items at Marlon's Adventure Guild
[*]Use weapons like any other weapons
[/list]
